title: Clearing Type
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:57 AM

Clearing Type

In Customizing for Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable, under |*Open Item Management » Clearing Control » Define
Clearing Types 3, define the clearing rules, depending on the clearing type.

The clearing type represents the business transaction, such as payment lot (05), cash desk (19), or manual account maintenance
(03). For the standard processes of incoming payments and account maintenance, the clearing type supplied by SAP corresponds

to the origin (origin key of document HERKF_ KK) of the clearing process.

The standard processes of Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable use the following clearing types:

Clearing Type                                           Description                                             Use

01                                                          Manual posting                                         Incoming payment
03                                                          Manual account maintenance                       Account maintenance
04                                                          Automatic account maintenance                   Account maintenance
05                                                          Payment lot                                             Incoming payment
06*                                                        Payment run                                            Payment run

(Assignment of an available amount, for
example, for incoming payment)

19                                                            Payment in the cash desk                             Incoming payment
25                                                          Check lot                                                 Incoming payment
55                                                          Credit card lot                                          Incoming payment

* Clearing type 06 is used in the configuration of the extended grouping in event O600.

The system uses the following clearing types to distribute the clearing amount to the dependent items:

Clearing Type                                           Description                                             Use

20R                                                              Distribute a payment to the original items        Distribute the clearing amount to the
of an installment plan                                 dependent items

20S                                                               Distribute a payment to the original items        Distribute the clearing amount to the
of a collective bill                                      dependent items

30G                                                              Distribute a payment to the line items of a        Distribute the clearing amount to the
summarization group                                 dependent items

i Note

A clearing type is also flagged if it controls the assignment of an available amount (Such as a payment) to the open items.
Otherwise, it only controls the assignment between the open items that have already been posted (account maintenance).
